resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give 1933. A 1931 newspaper item and a 1932 entry on the collection page show a lookout already in use. The story reports both and does not choose.
firelookout.com names the Winema National Forest; the collection page names the Fremont National Forest. The story reports both.

The register and the FFLA county list agree on 43.30271, -121.49176. The brief's other coordinate pair (43.30791, -121.49308, from the west_us_lookouts record) was not read in any source here, so it is not used.

notes_for_editor: Build date is unresolved: the register and firelookout.com say 1933, but a July 1931 item and a 1932 lightning-protection entry point to an earlier lookout. The story sets the 1942 memo's 61 ft 11 in (measured from ground to the cab floor) against the register's 60-foot figure and does not use it as height_m. Forest name differs between sources (Winema vs Fremont). The brief's second coordinate pair is not verified. The undated 'Removed' label on the collection page was not used. Last staffing record found is 1940. The register lists 1945 and 1948 photos but gives no image URLs. No access information found.
